{{Quote|Of all the things at risk, the loss of an objective reality is perhaps the most dangerous. The death of truth is the ultimate victory of evil. When truth leaves us, when we let it slip away, when it is ripped from our hands, we become vulnerable to the appetite of whatever monster screams the loudest. This chamber's hold on the truth was finally lost on the Ghorman Plaza. What took place yesterday… what happened yesterday on Ghorman was unprovoked genocide. Yes, genocide! And that truth has been exiled from this chamber! And the monster screaming the loudest? The monster we've helped create? The monster who will come for us all soon enough… is Emperor Palpatine!|Mon Mothma denounces [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]]|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>}}
'''Mon Mothma''', also known affectionately as '''Double-M''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Chandrilan]] [[Politics|politician]] and revolutionary leader who was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s founding members and its [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|civilian leader]]. During the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Era|Era]], Mothma [[Senator|represented]] her [[homeworld]] of [[Chandrila]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Republic Senate]] and, in this role, was an outspoken advocate of peace and [[democracy]] during the [[Clone Wars]], a pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] conflict between the Republic and its [[Raxus Address|splinter state]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] at the end of the war, Mothma retained her seat in the now-[[Imperial Senate]], but she began organizing underground resistance movements to combat the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] government alongside militant [[Luthen Rael]] and fellow senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]]. After years of leading a double life, Mothma became the impetus for the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|official establishment]] of the Rebel Alliance by resigning from the Senate, assuming leadership as [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] of the newly-established Rebel Alliance. The Rebellion, led by her, overthrew the Empire in the [[Galactic Civil War]] and restored the Old Republic as the nascent [[New Republic]], of which Mothma was its first [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]].

In accordance with Chandrilan custom, Mothma was [[Marriage|betrothed]] to [[Perrin Fertha]], and the pair moved to the galactic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]], where she began her tenure as senator of her homeworld, forming ties with several fellow progressively-minded senators, including Organa, [[Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia]], and later, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]]. Together, they strived to maintain the Republic's democratic ideals and loyalty to the government amidst the burgeoning [[Separatist Crisis]]. Despite their faction's efforts to alleviate the crisis, the Republic entered the Clone Wars. Mothma and her allies were vehemently opposed to the war and often led efforts to de-escalate the conflict and bring about a diplomatic solution, but they faced opposition from militarist senators and corporate entities. Her faction's peace initiatives and anti-war legislation often saw failure and pushback, such as the [[Death|murder]] of Senator Farr during controversy over a [[Reduced military spending bill|bid]] to overturn a [[Republic military enhancement bill|military funding increase]].

As the war drew to a close, Organa, Mothma, and Amidala [[Petition of 2,000|petitioned]] the increasingly-authoritarian [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] to rescind his [[Emergency Powers Act|executive wartime powers]] following the end of the war. To their horror, Palpatine—secretly the [[Sith]] [[Sith Lord|Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious—instead declared the [[Jedi Order]] guilty of [[treason]] and announced that he would transform the Republic into an Empire. Under the new regime, Mothma continued to serve in the now-Imperial Senate, and she and her allies did what they could to politically oppose Palpatine's reign, though she also involved herself in underground resistance. Carefully navigating various interests in both the Senate and the Rebellion, Mothma was pitted against numerous individuals, such as political rivals [[Ars Dangor]] and [[Sly Moore]]; Perrin, who had grown accustomed to the life of a [[consort]]; their [[Parent|daughter]] [[Leida Mothma|Leida]], with whom she had an estranged relationship; and Rael, who grew increasingly violent. Mothma, however, found comfort with individuals including Organa, his wife, [[Breha Organa|Breha]], their daughter, [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]], her cousin, [[Vel Sartha]], and her childhood friend, [[Tay Kolma]]. To hide her involvement with Rael's [[Axis network|rebel network]] from the Empire, Mothma betrothed her daughter to [[Stekan Sculdun]], son of Chandrilan oligarch [[Davo Sculdun]].

As the Empire increased its efforts to crack down on various rebel cells, Mothma continued with her struggle but found her influence diminishing and chances for peaceful settlement gone. When the Empire [[Ghorman Massacre|massacred peaceful protestors]] on the planet [[Ghorman]], Mothma [[Escape from the Senate|publicly denounced]] the Empire and resigned from the Senate, with the growing Rebellion [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|formally unified]] as the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The fugitive Mothma began working directly with the Alliance. As the conflict between the Rebellion and the Empire grew, large-scale warfare became inevitable. Upon receiving intel that the Empire was constructing a planet-killing [[superweapon]], Mothma sanctioned the recruitment of [[Jyn Erso]], who led the [[Rogue One]] [[squadron]] in stealing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans|plans]] during the [[Battle of Scarif|Battle of]] [[Scarif]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin|Battle of]] [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]] saw the [[battle station]]'s destruction, Mothma [[Commander-in-Chief|led]] the Alliance through its struggle, helping plan the [[Battle of Endor|Battle of]] [[Endor]] with the [[Alliance High Command]], which saw the apparent [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] Palpatine and left the Empire in chaos.

In Endor's immediate aftermath, the Rebel Alliance restored the Old Republic as the New Republic and resumed the [[Galactic Senate]] as the [[New Republic Senate]] on Chandrila. Mothma was elected as Chancellor, and intended to do away with the emergency wartime powers she inherited from Palpatine and demilitarize the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] by ninety percent while leaving the [[Planetary defense forces|defense]] of individual [[planet]]s to themselves. When the war finally came to an end, the Republic signed the [[Galactic Concordance]] with the Empire, and the Republic passed the [[Military Disarmament Act]]. The looming prospect of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]'s return to the galaxy was a watershed moment in her leadership. The end of Mothma's chancellery brought a close to a period of unity in the Republic, with several political factions, such as the [[Centrists]] and the [[Populists]], breaking out in disagreement over the best future for the new government.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Wizard! Teen senator takes on Coruscant|Headline of Bormea Today|<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
[[File:New_Senator_Mothma.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mothma sat in the Galactic Senate by 32 BBY.]]
Mon Mothma was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[48 BBY]]<ref name="Birth date" /> into a [[Politics|political]] [[Mothma family|family]]; her [[Mon Mothma's father|father]] was an [[arbiter-general]] in the [[Galactic Republic]], and her [[Tanis (Chandrila)|mother]] was a [[governor]] on their [[homeworld]] of [[Chandrila]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> She also had at least one cousin, [[Vel Sartha]].<ref name="Nobody's Listening">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref>

At the age of fifteen, during the Chandrilan [[winter]], Mothma fell in love, discovered [[smashball]], and realized her parents' imperfections. Because of that, she decided to turn her back on her family's political dynasty to become a [[historian]].<ref name="Rogue One novel" /> In order to discourage her from pursing this career path, her parents arranged for a tour for Mothma, accompanied by her personal tutor, to the obscure ruins of the unpopulated planet of [[Phothrell]], in hopes that she would become bored. Instead, while exploring the theaters in the [[Palace of the High Games Masters]] for a full day, she imagined the holographic game pieces and the crowds, and inquired her tutor many questions he was neither able to answer or inclined to learn about.<ref name="MOF" />

Around the same [[33 BBY|time]], Mothma [[Wedding of Perrin Fertha and Mon Mothma|married]] [[Perrin Fertha]], a fellow Chandrilan.<ref name="Narkina 5" /> By the next [[summer]], however, her moment of rebellion had been forgotten, and she had returned to politics, both because of family pressures and a genuine love of governance.<ref name="Rogue One novel" /> Around [[32 BBY]],<ref name="MOFSenateJoinDate">{{MOFdate|45}} During Mon Mothma's interrogation in ''Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear'', Chapter 45, she says she first joined the Senate thirteen years prior to the events of the novel, which are set in 19 BBY.</ref> she joined the Republic's [[Galactic Senate]],<ref name="Queen's Shadow" /> becoming one of the youngest [[senator]]s to date.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Dictionary" /> At sixteen, Mothma and Perrin, having been married for about a year, moved to Coruscant together, with Mothma serving as senator.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

Months after their wedding, they carried a passionate and spiteful romance. At the age of twenty, Fertha and Mothma had a falling out and decided to that there would be no children, no shared bed, and no questions between them. At the age of twenty-four, they grew closer, despite previous periods of varying closeness and distance in the relationship, eventually arriving at an equilibrium<ref name="MOF" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="MOFDate">{{MOFdate|6}}</ref> in which they lived separate lives, while maintaining some degree of communication.<ref name="MOF" />

In [[28 BBY]],<ref name="QS Date">The main story of ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' takes place four [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[32 BBY]].</ref> Mothma spoke at the first senate meeting attended by Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Chommell sector]] as well as several other new senators. Mothma was initially skeptical of Amidala due to her decision to call a vote of no confidence against former [[Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]] thus putting the needs of her home world of [[Naboo]] above the needs of the [[galaxy]] as a whole.<ref name="Queen's Shadow" /> Although a dedicated and passionate believer in the Republic, Mothma was aware of its shortcomings and threats the Republic faced.<ref name="HC 40">{{HelmetCollectionCite|40|Databank A-Z}}</ref> Around this time, Mothma became suspicious of her fellow senator, [[Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon]], and hosted a party where Mothma staged a distraction so that she could discuss the matter with her allies Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and Senator [[Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia]] in Mothma's [[garden]]s while unknowingly being watched by Senator Amidala.<ref name="Queen's Shadow" />

Mothma was a member of Organa's [[committee for transportation of construction materials]] along with Amidala and Farr. Following her eventual alliance with Amidala she used her contacts to stop the [[TriNebulon News]] from publishing negative stories on her.<ref name="Queen's Shadow" /> Mothma eventually became one of Amidala's closest allies but not one of her closest friends.<ref name="Queen's Hope">''[[Queen's Hope]]''</ref> Eventually, Mothma became one of Amidala's friends and mentors, as Mothma believed that Amidala was one of the best hopes for preserving the Republic. Mothma was one of the most steadfast supporters for peace, and was widely respected throughout the Republic.<ref name="Join the Battle">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars and the death of the Republic===
====An advocate for peace====
[[File:Mon_Mothma_in_the_Senate.png|thumb|right|300px|Mon Mothma represented the planet Chandrila in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars.]]
Joining the senate at a critical time, the [[Separatist Crisis]] grew to being on the verge of all out war. As part of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee]], Mothma continued to work closely with Senators Amidala and Organa. Together, they worked to oppose the arming of the Republic and the increasing calls for war against the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HC 40" /> As a member of the Loyalists, Mothma and the other senators were tasked to maintain the Republic's integrity.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> When an [[Dogfight over Geonosis|investigation]] by the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> on [[Geonosis]] revealed that the Confederacy, also known as the Separatists, had already created a large [[droid]] military force and a [[Cloning|clone]] [[army]] was discovered on [[Kamino]] and previously commissioned secretly by a Jedi,<ref name="HC 40" /> the galaxy plunged into the [[Clone Wars]], beginning with the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II" />

Although Mothma and the Loyalist Committee seemed out of step with the new realities of the conflict, they continued to work towards a peaceful solution.<ref name="HC 40" /> Mothma became an outspoken opponent of the war with the Separatists, and along with friends and allies, like Amidala and Organa, came to fear that the Republic's push to defeat the Separatists made it blind to the toll that the war would take on the Republic. She warned that wartime measures, such as the increasing scope of the emergency powers that the Galactic Senate gave the chancellor, were a threat to democracy. It was the desire of Mothma and her allies to find a peaceful solution to the Clone Wars, and Mothma served as a mentor to Amidala as the young senator became one of the leading advocates for peace in the Republic.<ref name="Mon Mothma Bio Gallery">{{SW|url=mon-mothma-biography-gallery|text=Mon Mothma Biography Gallery}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Malastare]], the Grand Army of the Republic discovered a creature known as the [[Zillo Beast]] that dwelled underneath the surface of the planet [[Malastare]]. Having been given a way to the surface by the bombardments during the battle, the Zillo Beast fought against the Republic Army, and it was discovered that the creature was nearly-indestructible.<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> In the hopes of replicating the indestructibility for use in [[clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper armor|armor]], Chancellor Palpatine approved the creature's relocation to [[Coruscant]], the [[capital]] of the Republic. The Zillo Beast escaped from captivity and made its way towards the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] to find the chancellor, who had ordered the beast be destroyed so its indestructible scales could be removed for testing and replication. The creature [[Zillo Beast incident|attacked]] the Senate Office Building, and Mothma was present during the attack, walking the corridors of power with Senator Organa. The Republic and the [[Jedi]] soon eliminated the creature, bringing an end to the threat against the Senate.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

[[File:Monmoth.png|thumb|left|200px|Mothma watches the full recording of Deputy Minister Jerec, who argued against a Republic occupation of Mandalore.]]
The neutrality of the planet [[Mandalore]], led by [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]], soon came into dispute when the Mandalorian splinter group known as [[Death Watch]] threatened to overthrow the pacifist [[New Mandalorians|New Mandalorian]] government that the duchess led. The Senate debated whether or not to send military assistance to Mandalore, a move that the duchess strongly opposed—and one that the Separatists hoped the Republic would enact, as they believed that the people of Mandalore would greet the Death Watch as liberators fighting against a Republic occupation force. The Senate initially voted to send an occupation force, based on doctored evidence suggesting that Mandalore's [[Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec]] called for a Republic presence on his world to combat Death Watch. In actuality, the full recording of Jerec showed that he argued strongly against a military occupation. Mothma was present in the Senate session in which Jerec's true words were broadcast, and the Senate ultimately voted against sending Republic forces to Mandalore.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

In response to the growing number of refugees displaced by the ongoing war with the Separatists, Amidala and Organa led a [[Alderaan Refugee Conference|conference]] to discuss and, hopefully, resolve the issue. The conference took place on the planet Alderaan, and Mothma was in attendance. She and Organa greeted Amidala, the keynote speaker, when she arrived on Alderaan and escorted her to her quarters. The conference was briefly disrupted when a [[bounty hunter]], [[Aurra Sing]], attempted to assassinate Amidala on behalf of the [[Prison|imprisoned]] [[crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] the [[Hutt]], but the conference continued onward when Amidala was saved by [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Assassin">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref> Soon after, Senator Mothma attended a party thrown by Amidala in Amidala's apartment in honor of Senator [[Aang]], a member of the [[Military Oversight Committee]] who was persuaded to vote in favor of reducing military spending.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>

====Military funding debate====
{{Quote|My dear, you were brilliant.''"<br />"''Thank you, but perhaps we should wait until we actually win the vote before we make a victory speech.|Mon Mothma and Padmé Amidala, following the latter's speech arguing against increased military spending|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
[[File:AToast-SM.png|thumb|right|300px|Senators like Mothma, Amidala, and Onaconda Farr were outspoken opponents of increased military spending.]]
The Galactic Senate became embroiled in debates regarding the cost of fighting the Clone Wars. A particularly passionate topic of debate was whether the Senate should fund the creation of more clone troopers to combat the Separatist Alliance, despite the Republic nearing bankruptcy as a result of the war. Senator [[Gume Saam]] argued in favor of a bill that would open new lines of credit to fund the Republic's war effort. Mothma spoke out against the measure, arguing that it would essentially deregulate the banks. The Senate, at Organa's urging, tabled any decision on the proposal until the matter could be considered further. After an [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|attack]] by Separatist [[Infiltrator demolition droid|demolition droids]] destroyed Coruscant's [[central power distribution grid]], the Senate voted on the measure and opted to deregulate the banks in order to open additional lines of credit to fund the war effort.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>

Despite the passage of the bank deregulation, the debate over increased military funding continued. Senator [[Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino]], the source of the clone troopers, proposed legislation to create five million additional clone soldiers. Organa intended to speak before the Senate in opposition to the bill, but he was injured in an attack by Separatist-aligned bounty hunters [[Chata Hyoki]] and [[Robonino]]. As the Senate awaited his address, representatives in favor of Burtoni's bill urged the Senate to vote, while Mothma insisted that the bill's opposition, which included herself, be allowed to speak out against the legislation. With Organa too injured to speak, Amidala addressed the Senate on his behalf, giving an impassioned plea to oppose increased military funding so as to continue funding critical social services for the people of the Republic.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

[[File:Onacondafarrdead.png|thumb|left|300px|Senator Onaconda Farr collapses and soon dies after drinking poison, as Mothma and other senators look on.]]
The Senate prepared to vote on the measure, and the bill's opposition continued working to persuade their fellow senators to vote against the increase in military spending. Mothma worked with Amidala, Organa, and Farr in the efforts, and Amidala delivered another speech to the Senate on behalf of their position. The speech was greeted with enthusiasm from the Senate, and Mothma and the other opposition senators celebrated Amidala's address over drinks. Mothma told her former protégé that she did brilliantly, though Amidala was reluctant to feel victorious until such time as Burtoni's bill was struck down. Burtoni herself crashed the conversation, suggesting that the opposition was loyal to the Separatists. Mothma urged the feuding representatives to end their argument, and Farr forced Burtoni to leave the gathering. The senator from Chandrila then praised Farr for leading the efforts against the bill, and the Rodian expressed regret for once siding with the Separatists against the Republic. Mothma assured him, however, that he was now doing the right thing by helping defeat the military spending increase. Farr unexpectedly collapsed after his drink was unknowingly [[poison]]ed, so Mothma ran to find help for the dying senator of Rodia. After his death, Mothma attended a memorial service for Farr on a Coruscant landing platform, before the senator's body was returned home.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

After the service, Mothma attended a meeting in Chancellor Palpatine's [[Emperor's office|office]], where [[Lieutenant]] [[Tanivos Exantor Divo|Tan Divo]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force]] shared his theory that Farr had been murdered. After the meeting, Mothma conversed with Amidala, Organa, and Farr's aide [[Lolo Purs]]. Mothma wondered who would have wanted to harm Farr, and, despite Divo's theory that the murder was a result of a secret from Farr's past, Purs speculated that the assassination was the result of Farr's opposition to the spending bill. Organa urged them to put an end to speculation and double their efforts on defeating the bill, but Amidala insisted that they delay the vote until Farr's murderer was apprehended, lest senators vote in favor of the measure in order to avoid harm coming to themselves. Organa agreed to put a delay motion before the Senate while Amidala said she would conduct her own investigation. Mothma questioned her decision, as Divo had asked them not to interfere, but Amidala was sure that they could resolve the case better than Divo, in whom she had little confidence. Organa worried that such an investigation could disrupt the coalition against the bill, a concern that Mothma shared. Knowing that Amidala would see it through anyway, Mothma recommended that Amidala bring her head of security, [[Captain]] [[Gregar Typho]], with her, but Amidala preferred to handle it alone. At Mothma's insistence, however, Amidala agreed to work with Senator Organa on her investigation.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

During the course of their investigation, Amidala and Organa were targeted for death by the assassin. They were discovered by Lieutenant Divo, who later met with the opposition group, including Mothma, and theorized that the killer was targeting the opposition leadership. Divo placed the group under his protection as he continued the investigation, though Purs left after objecting to having themselves all kept in one room as an easy target. Purs soon returned, claiming she had been attacked by Burtoni, one of the suspects in the murder, which Burtoni laughingly denied. She also denied being involved in the assassination of Senator Farr. Despite suspicion falling onto Burtoni, Amidala realized that Purs had to have been the assassin; the poison targeted Rodians, so Purs would have died too if only she had taken a drink. Her duplicity having been discovered, Purs admitted to killing Farr due to his brief allegiance to the Separatist Alliance, and Purs was arrested for her crime. Soon thereafter, the Senate voted on the funding bill and passed the measure in spite of the opposition efforts of Mothma and the others, leading to the production of more clone troopers.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

====The war continues====
[[File:BecLawiseLetsContinue-AFIN.png|thumb|right|300px|Mothma, along with Amidala and Organa, attends a peace conference with Separatist representatives on Mandalore.]]
As the war progressed, a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference|peace conference]] was held between the Republic and the Separatists on the neutral planet of Mandalore, overseen by Duchess Satine. Mothma, Amidala, and Organa represented the Republic in the conference, while three members of the [[Separatist Senate]] represented the interests of the Separatist Alliance. The Separatists demanded that the three senators, as representatives for Chancellor Palpatine, recognize the legitimacy of the Separatist Alliance's existence, a stance that the senators were reluctant to take. The talks were disrupted by [[Lux Bonteri]], son of the assassinated Separatist Senator [[Mina Bonteri]], and asserted that [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the leader of the Separatist Alliance, was behind his mother's death. Bonteri was removed from the talks by [[Commando Droid Diplomat]]s,<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref> but the talks did not result in peace between the two sides.<ref name="Mon Mothma Bio Gallery" />

The Jedi soon learned that a criminal named [[Moralo Eval]] had hatched a plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine. In order to infiltrate the conspiracy, led by Count Dooku himself, [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] faked his death so his face could be surgically altered to look like the bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen]], who had fired the shot that supposedly killed the Jedi Master. Believing that Kenobi was dead, Mothma attended the [[Funeral of Obi-Wan Kenobi|funeral]] held for the Jedi Master in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> Kenobi ultimately disrupted the plot to kidnap the Chancellor, and Palpatine was left unharmed.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

[[File:TempleBombingFuneral.png|thumb|left|300px|Mothma was one of many dignitaries who attended a funeral for the victims of the Jedi Temple bombing.]]
Some time later, Mothma attended yet another funeral in the Jedi Temple, this one for the victims of the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] that killed several Jedi and civilians alike.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Mothma was a member of the court that would decide the fate of Ahsoka Tano, who was arrested and charged with being the mastermind of the temple attack. Tano was prosecuted by [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and defended by Senator Amidala. Ultimately, it was discovered that Jedi Knight [[Barriss Offee]], who had grown disillusioned with the [[Jedi High Council]] for their leadership in the continuing Clone Wars, was responsible for the plot and had framed her friend and former fellow Padawan for the attack. Tano was freed from Republic custody and chose not to return to the Jedi Order, as she was unwilling to return after the Jedi Council did not trust her innocence.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

Later in the war, former Senator [[Rush Clovis]] was installed as the leader of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. He was merely a pawn of Count Dooku, however, and his installation as leader led to a Separatist invasion of [[Scipio]], the headquarters of the Banking Clan. The Senate voted to authorize a Republic military strike against the Separatist invasion force, and the Republic was able to repel the Separatists. In response to the actions of the Separatist Alliance, and following the death of Rush Clovis, the Banking Clan senator [[Nix Card]] ceded control of the banks, [[Muunilinst|save one branch]], to Chancellor Palpatine, a move that Mothma reacted to with disapproval. Palpatine promised to reinstate private control of the banks when the Clone Wars were over but urged that it was necessary to ensure financial stability in the interim, a stance that most of the Senate greeted with enthusiastic approval, since the Republic was saved from bankruptcy.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref> Shortly thereafter, Mothma was present in a Senate session in which [[King|Queen]] [[Julia]] of the neutral planet [[Bardotta]] spoke via [[hologram]] and requested the Republic's assistance in uncovering why Bardottan spiritual leaders were disappearing. At the queen's request, the Republic sent [[Gungan]] representative [[Jar Jar Binks]], as well as Jedi Master [[Mace Windu]], to help resolve the situation.<ref name="Disappeared 1">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part I}}</ref>

====Ahsoka Tano's trial====
Mothma was present during the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims|funeral]] of the six Jedi killed in the [[bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar]]. She also attended the [[trial of Ahsoka Tano]], who was represented by Amidala, and was seated alongside [[Riyo Chuchi]], Organa, and [[Kin Robb]] as the former Padawan was accused of masterminding the bombing. Tano was ultimately cleared of all charges when [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived with another Jedi Padwan [[Barriss Offee]], who was the real culprit.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

Mothma witnessed Offee's confess to her crimes as she explained she, like many others, had come to realize that the Jedi were responsible for the war and they had lost their way becoming the villains in the conflict saying that they should be the ones on trial and that her attack on the Temple was an attack on what the Jedi had become, an army fighting for the dark side, having fallen from the light which they had once held so dear. Offee then stated that the Republic was falling and that it was only a matter of time, before she was pulled back by Skywalker. She was then taken away on the orders of Palpatine.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

====Final days of the war====
{{Quote|We are loyalists, trying to preserve democracy in the Republic.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref>}}
[[File:PadmeROTS2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|A meeting of loyalist senators, such as Mothma, planted the seeds of organized rebellion against Palpatine.]]
In the final days of the Clone Wars, the Chancellor continued to amass more executive powers. However, in [[19 BBY]], he was captured by [[General]] [[Grievous]] and taken hostage aboard his ship. As a [[Battle of Coruscant|battle]] broke out between the Republic and the Confederacy, Skywalker and Kenobi rushed to Palpatine's rescue. They managed to retrieve their kidnapped Chancellor, killing Count Dooku in the process. In the wake of the rescue and subsequent battle, Organa gathered outside the Senate Building with the Loyalist Committee, and they all greeted Palpatine.<ref name="Episode III" />

Palpatine was soon given control of the Jedi Council, and he soon began appointing regional governors to oversee all [[star system]]s in the Republic. Alarmed by these abrupt chain of events, a small group of concerned senators, such as Organa, Amidala, Mothma, and [[Meena Tills]], met in Organa's office at [[Cantham House]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Dictionary" /> Throughout these events, Mothma and Senator Organa met in secret, even from their allies, to discuss basic plans for an organized and armed rebellion against the possibility that Palpatine may become a tyrant.<ref name="HC 40" /> These meetings eventually set the spark for a highly secret Rebellion movement.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

Later, Mothma and the rest of the senators met in [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Padmé Amidala's apartment]], where Mothma told them that they were forming an alliance to stop Palpatine. However, Padmé suggested bringing the plan to the one Jedi she trusts, but Mothma and the group agreed with Organa to appeal to the Senate first.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

[[File:OrganaMothmaFuneral-Resolve.png|thumb|right|300px|Mothma attended the funeral of her dear friend, Padmé Amidala.]]
The Clone Wars came to a close following the deaths of Count Dooku and the droid [[General]] [[Grievous]]. Skywalker discovered that Palpatine was secretly Darth Sidious, a [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] who had manipulated the entire conflict to gain power over the Republic. Mace Windu and three other Jedi Masters attempted to arrest the chancellor, but the Dark Lord killed them all and seduced Skywalker to the [[dark side of the Force]], anointing him as the [[Sith Lord]] Darth Vader. Having found justification to eliminate his enemies, Palpatine declared the Jedi Order to be enemies of the Republic and ordered Darth Vader and clone troopers across the galaxy to destroy the Jedi. A disfigured Chancellor, injured in his [[Duel in Palpatine's office|confrontation]] with Master Windu, spoke to the Senate about the so-called Jedi betrayal and [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] that, in the interest of stability and security, the Republic would be reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire]]. The worst fears of Mothma and her allies were confirmed, and Amidala died soon thereafter on the asteroid Polis Massa.<ref name="Episode III" /> Mothma soon met with Bail, and together they attended Padmé's funeral on Theed alongside thousands of others.<ref name="Resolve">{{TOTJ|Resolve (episode)}}</ref>

During the [[senatorial arrests]], Mothma was among the senators charged with colluding with the Jedi Order and treason, yet she, like Bail Organa, was released after publicly claiming to be a loyal Imperial.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Amidala's death was blamed on the Jedi Rebellion, but Mothma, who attended [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|her close friend's funeral]], knew who was really at fault — Palpatine. Vowing to return democracy to the galaxy,<ref name="Mon Mothma card">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Mon Mothma - Senator of Chandrila}}</ref> Mothma and Organa continued to prepare for resistance to the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] rule.<ref name="Mon Mothma Bio Gallery" />

====An attempt to restore democracy====
{{Quote|I've laid out a framework for what I'm calling the Imperial Rebirth Act. My goal is not to create a public stir or incur the ire of Palpatine's supporters. I will argue this bill clarifies the new division of powers, that it will streamline decision-making and guide future legislation in this bold new era. In reality, the bill is designed to secure the Senate's position and avert executive overreach while allowing Palpatine to save face.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="MOF" />}}
In 19 BBY,<ref name="MOFDateRebirthAct">{{MOFdate|6}}</ref> in order to try to curb Emperor Palpatine's executive power, Mothma drafted the [[Imperial Rebirth Act]]. She sought political support for the bill among the members of the Delegation of the 2,000, former Separatists worlds under the leadership of [[Tychon Nulvolio]], and powerful magnates [[Arvik Cornade]], [[Baron]] [[Shkan-Shkan Yew]], and [[Hasalia Prederiko]]. During that time, Mothma had her apartment broken into by [[Thalvus Agyomenidus]], a radicalized member of the pro-Imperial activist group [[4040s]], who killed her aide and Imperial spy [[Zhuna]]. Mothma and her husband were relocated to a temporary apartment by [[Senate Security]], which also was broken into sometime later.<ref name="MOF" />

In the context of the Empire's spying on Senator Bail Organa during his [[investigation into the framing of the Jedi]], Mothma was again imprisoned and interrogated over her association with Organa, and released sometime after.<ref name="MOF" />

As a precondition for Organa's support for her bill, she agreed to meet up with former Separatist operative [[Soujen Vak-Nhalis]] and share his evidence with the Senate of the falsification of records that were used as justification for branding the Jedi traitors. Mothma and Vak-Nhalis, whose true plan was to [[Attack on the Executive Center|kill the Emperor]], headed to the [[Imperial Executive Building]]. Mothma had previously learned from Nulvolio that, amidst the modifications Vak-Nhalis underwent, a self-destruction mechanism was also added, triggered by the sound of the words "oubliette" and "sublime." Fearing that Vak-Nhalis's attempt on Palpatine's life would make it politically impossible to pass her bill, she activated the detonation, killing Vak-Nhalis and wounding herself in the process.<ref name="MOF" />

In the aftermath of the explosion, Mothma spent over a week at a [[medcenter]] in recovery, during which the Imperial Rebirth Act passed in the Senate. Sometime thereafter, Grand Vizier Mas Amedda met with Mothma, and revealed that Palpatine was to veto provisions of her bill that limited the Emperor's powers, citing his [[century plan]] for the galaxy. Amedda took her to see to the reeducation camp [[Center One]], where political prisoners were jailed, in an attempt to keep Mothma in line.<ref name="MOF" />

Mothma continued serving in the Senate by [[7 BBY]], where she and Senator Organa spent a lot of time pleading with their fellow senators to recognize the state of the Empire, but their speeches were dismissed without further consideration.<ref name="RebelRising">''[[Rebel Rising]]''</ref>

===The Rebel Alliance===
====Rebellion from within====
{{Quote|Don't lecture me on vulnerability. No one's more at risk than I am. You think I haven't thought this through? I'd be the first one to fall.|Mothma to Luthen Rael, on their rebel practices|<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Senator_Mothma-Andor.png|thumb|left|300px|Senator Mothma in the Imperial Senate]]
Though Mothma and Organa remained members of the [[Imperial Senate]], they understood that the political group was now irrelevant, and that the time came for rebellion. While Organa dealt with the military aspects of building a rebellion and grew its network of intelligence agents, Mothma further developed political alliances that were made during the final moments of the Republic. Mothma understood that those alliances would be key for any future galactic governance after either the defeat or the reform of the Empire.<ref name="HC 40" /> Before Amidala died, she secretly gave [[Reproduction|birth]] to [[twin]]s: [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the latter of whom was adopted by Organa and his wife, Queen [[Breha Organa]].<ref name="Episode III" /> Mothma knew the adopted [[Princess]] from an early age and watched as she grew to become a politician in her own right. Mothma became the princess' political tutor, teaching her before she took her father's place in the [[Imperial Senate]], and watched as the princess became a leader in the emerging rebellion against the Empire.<ref name="Moving Target" />

Around [[18 BBY]],<ref name="18 BBY Date">{{AndorDate|105}} {{Databank|leida-mothma|Leida Mothma}} establishes that Leida Mothma was thirteen [[Standard year|years]] old at the [[time]] of the episode, placing her [[Reproduction|birth]] around [[18 BBY]].</ref> Mothma and Perrin had a child, a daughter named [[Leida Mothma]].<ref name="Databank Leida" /> Mon and Leida had a distant relationship, with Mon also hiding her rebellious activities from her daughter<ref name="Space Moms">{{InsiderCite|221|Space Moms}}</ref> and husband.<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> While there were times she wanted to tell Leida about the hidden part of her career, Mon decided that keeping Leida out of the loop kept her safe.<ref name="Space Moms" />

While continuing her work in the Imperial Senate, Mothma continued to expand on the loose network of rebel cells she began calling "the Alliance." These groups included organizations such as the [[Atrivis Resistance Group]], which joined Mothma's network in 5 BBY.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="AndorDate">{{AndorDate|104}}</ref> Mothma visited [[Luthen Rael]]'s [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]] on Coruscant, claiming to buy a present for her husband for his [[Day of Days]]. In reality, however, Mothma had come to speak with Rael, whom she was trying to smuggle [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]] to in order to feed the [[Axis network|rebel network]] he was running. By this time, the Empire had begun sending spies after Mothma, including her new driver, [[Exmar Kloris|Kloris]], meaning she was unable to transfer the money. Upon her arrival, Rael led the senator to the back of the gallery, feigning to show her military artifacts her husband would enjoy. She told Rael that she was looking to lean Perrin's interest from ancient weapons, to other objects. He then brought her to the back to show her other items. Once in the back, Mothma informed Rael that she had found someone who they could bring into their circle, but Luthen dismissed this as they were vulnerable enough. Mothma, however, told him not to lecture her on vulnerability, as if they were discovered, she would be the first to fall. Mothma then left the gallery and quietly observed Coruscant on her way [[Chandrilan Embassy|home]].<ref name="Aldhani" />

[[File:Leida-Andor5.png|thumb|right|200px|Mothma's daughter Leida Mothma]]

[[File:TayKolma.png|thumb|left|250px|At a party, hosted at her apartment, Mothma asked her old friend Tay Kolma for help]]
Later that night, Mothma hosted a party at her apartment, where she talked with her school friend, the [[bank]]er [[Tay Kolma]]. The pair were then interrupted by Fertha who assumed that they were reminiscing about their school days and reminded the pair of an upcoming reunion. Mothma then left the living room with Fertha to talk to some of the other guests.<ref name="Announcement" />

====Opposition to authoritarian measures====
{{Quote|In the Imperial Senate a common joke about Mon Mothma, as she would later recount, was that she was obsessed with trying to save the Empire from the Emperor.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="RiseFall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>}}
Mothma was a prominent opponent of the new authoritarian laws that Emperor Palpatine introduced to the Imperial Senate following a [[Aldhani heist|rebel attack in Aldhani]],<ref name="Narkina 5" /> specifically the [[Imperial Emergency Act]] and the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]].<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> Mothma hosted a banquet on Coruscant with the ulterior motive of attempting to muster enough votes to stop the legislation, deciding to present the argument of saving the Empire from the Emperor. Once Fertha left Mothma's side, Kolma, who was attending the party, warned Mothma that the Empire's new banking laws would hinder their operations. After speaking with many senators and giving a speech about how young she and Fertha were when they came to Coruscant, Fertha revealed that Kolma left early.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

Mothma was particularly critical of the PORD legislation, which she voiced opposition to in the Senate and called "the next step of an all too predictable march toward complete unchallenged authority". Her opposition raised a certain amount of debate, but the acts were eventually passed nonetheless. Later that day, Mothma's cousin Vel Sartha arrived at the embassy with a dress as a gift for Leida. While Mothma pressed Sartha to figure out why she had been gone for so long, Sartha kept her activities vague and avoided discussing Rael's activities by reminding Mothma of their vow of secrecy.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> Unbeknownst to Mothma, Sartha had been one of the rebels who performed the heist on Aldhani.<ref name="The Eye" /> The next day, Mothma encouraged Sartha to keep playing of the part of spoiled rich girl to hide her true actions before Sartha left for Chandrila.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

====Financing Rebellion====
Kolma approached Mothma with concerns that the large sums of money Mothma was moving would be noticed by the Empire soon. Deciding that she needed a loan, Kolma suggested going to wealthy criminal banker [[Davo Sculdun]] for help. Kolma noted that Sculdun would not concern himself with what Mothma was doing with her money, but Mothma was still hesitant to work with Sculdun.<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> Eventually, Kolma arranged a meeting between him, Mothma, and Sculdun. Sculdun offered solutions to make Mothma's transactions harder to detect by increased Imperial scrutiny, and initially indicated that he would do it for free. However, Sculdun revealed that his price was an introduction between his son [[Stekan Sculdun]] and Leida, suggesting the Chandrilan betrothal tradition that Mothma had taken part in as a teenager and thus resented. When Sculdun confirmed that was his only offer, Mothma said she would not consider it, but Sculdun stated that he knew she was lying and was actually considering it.<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

Later, Mothma and Sartha watched Leida participate in a traditional Chandrilan courtship ritual involving other young girls and an elder, that Leida had decided to participate in of her own volition, both realizing that Leida is actually supportive of traditions that they consider archaic. While they watch, Mothma explained her financial situation to Sartha, including her plans with Kolma that were jeopardized by the missing credits on her ledger. She revealed that she had kept the extent of the situation hidden from Rael, but suggested she may have found a solution.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>

Mothma's desperation to avoid her rebel activities from being exposed via her banking records<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> led to her agreeing to [[Davo Sculdun]]'s proposal.<ref name="Rix Road">{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}</ref> Mothma introduced Leida to his son, [[Stekan Sculdun]], putting both on the road to an arranged marriage.<ref name="One Way Out" />

====Leia's Day of Demand====
{{Quote|There comes a time when refusing to stop violence can no longer be called nonviolence. We cease to be objectors and become bystanders. At some point, morality must be wedded to action, or else it's no more than mere...vanity. |Senator Mon Mothma|<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan">''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ApprenticeLegislator-LeiaManga.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Mothma helped Leia Organa during her time as an Apprentice Legislator]]
In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="LPOA Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] birth in [[19 BBY]]. The events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' commence just after Organa's sixteenth [[birthday]], which places the events of the novel in [[3 BBY]].</ref> Mothma attended [[Leia Organa's Day of Demand]] at the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]], where she smiled wider as Leia passed, along with several dinner parties hosted at the palace which actually served as strategy meetings for the growing rebellion. By that time, with Mothma serving as the [[Senior Senator]] of Chandrila, she was joined in her Chandrilian delegation of the Senate by Senator [[Winmey Lenz]].<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan" />

Before one of these dinner parties, Mothma talked with Princess Leia about her time in the [[Apprentice Legislature]]. Leia confessed her guilt to Mothma about falling for a trick planted by the Empire as she had recommended [[Arreyel]] to be chosen for the location of a new [[Imperial Academy]] which allowed the Empire to run scans that showed the existence of a powerful radiation source under under the planet's crust. The Empire then began plans to use the source in planet-wide factories and gave the population six weeks to evacuate with no compensation. Mothma reassured Leia that Palpatine and his higher ups were skilled at those things and that even she herself had fallen for them a few times. Mothma moved into the banquet hall for the dinner party, shortly after, where they discussed the recent [[Strike on Onoam|assassination]] of [[Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka|Panaka]] and the idea of implementing further violence into their plans. Mothma pointed out that at some point refusing to fight stopped being nonviolence and instead of being objectors they became bystanders. Like Breha Organa, Mothma tried to get Bail to recognize that a large scale military rebellion was the only way to rife the galaxy of Palpatine and the Empire.<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan" />

The next day, Leia visited Mothma in her [[Mon Mothma's Senate office|office]] with proof of the Empire's actions towards the planet [[Chasmeene]], having punished them for failing to meet the Imperial quota by irradiation of vast swaths of its farmland, which led to planet wide famine. Mothma told Leia that there was very little that could be done with the evidence that she'd gathered. Mothma explained to Leia that worlds such as Chasmeene weren't subject to as much propaganda and that it wasn't ignorance, but rather tyranny and fear, that kept worlds within the Empire. Mothma did reassure Leia, however, that evidence, such as the one she gathered, would be useful for when Palpatine fell and they would need to "rewrite their false history to reflect the truth". Mothma also told Leia that she was honoured that Leia had trusted her with this as the Empire had worked hard to destroy peoples faith in each other and that it was only by reaching out that they would be able to make the allies they needed. When Leia hoped that one day she would be one of those allies, Mothma reassured her that she already was.<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan" />

At another one of the dinner parties, [[Grand Moff]] Tarkin unexpectedly attended and in order to hide the true purpose of the gathering Queen Breha pretended to drunkenly accuse her husband and Mothma of having an affair resulting in Princess Leia bursting into tears and Tarkin stomping out. The Organas' allies then realized that Leia was aware of their dangerous and illegal activities and were greatly angered that Bail and Breha had allowed their child to know about it. Mothma then told everyone that Leia Organa wasn't a child as she had had her [[Day of Demand]] and was on the verge of becoming an adult. Mothma said that Leia was growing into a "representative of the next generation", a generation she said would do most of the fighting and dying in what was to come.<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan" />

Later, Mothma attended the [[Coronation of the Alderaanian heir|ceremony]] where Leia was officially invested as [[crown]] princess of Alderaan.<ref name="Leia Princess of Alderaan" /> The young Organa would go onto join the Imperial Senate. Like Leia, Mothma would support a refugee rights bill in the Senate that kept refugees safe from exploitation. After it passed, it cost a [[Unidentified chief operating officer|chief operating officer]] on Coruscant billions, which eventually led to her putting a bounty out on both Mothma and Leia.<ref name="The Princess and the Scoundrel">''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]''</ref>

====Resigning for the Rebellion====
=====Final speech in the Senate=====
{{Quote|Here we are. This day has finally come.''"<br />"''You don't have to do this.''"<br />"''If you're brave enough to stay, I should be brave enough to go.|Mon Mothma and Bail Organa, before the former's address to the senate and escape|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
[[File:Welcome-SenatorialArrest.png|thumb|left|250px|Ghorman senator Dasi Oran is arrested.]]
Following the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in 2 BBY, Senator [[Dasi Oran]] was arrested without a warrant or charges levied against him in the Senate Building, in front of a wide range of senators, including Mothma and Bail Organa. Following the arrest, Mothma appealed to Organa's significant power and seniority in the senate with the hope that she could be included in the next session's order of business. The scale of the misinformation campaign against the Ghorman people had reached extreme levels, but Mon asserted that the lies were obvious and felt it was important to speak up even when the Empire's significant control over the senate meant that it would be hard for her to get time on the floor. However, she and Organa both agreed the speech would be potent enough to cause retaliation, and based the decision to speak upon the idea that Mon would flee Coruscant and forfeit her position as senator immediately thereafter. Organa informed her that he would organise a team to extract her, but that he would stay within the senate for a longer period as to keep the Empire's anxieties at bay.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

Following this discussion, Mon spent a whole night in the senate writing and preparing her speech, but also checking, with the help of [[Erskin Semaj]] - her senatorial attaché, for listening devices in her office following Organa's assertion that [[Ton|Senator Ton]] had found a listening device in her own. Upon its discovery, she destroyed it, provoking the interests of ISB agents. Under the incorrect impression that more listening devices may exist, she left her office to practice her speech in a plaza of the Senate, where she was approached by Luthen Rael, who revealed Semaj was one of his agents and had been since the wedding of Mon's daughter, Leida. Luthen also revealed that there was a mole within the extraction team provided by Bail Organa, information he was given by ISB Supervisor [[Lonni Jung]]. He offered an alternative solution to Organa's team: extraction by Cassian Andor using the code phrase 'I have friends everywhere'.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> This meeting was the final time that the two would encounter.<ref name="Legacy of Luthen and Mon">{{InsiderCite|233|The Legacy of Luthen Rael and Mon Mothma}}</ref>

[[File:WelcometotheRebellion-EpisodeThumbnail.png|thumb|right|300px|Mothma delivers her speech to the Senate.]]
The following day the senate session started with the ISB, senators, and the press under the impression that Mothma would not be speaking - [[Lagret|ISB Supervisor Lagret]] informed one of his officers that he had received the senate's agenda and Mon was not on it. However, Senator [[Erveen]], the senator from [[Hodi]] and a respected figure as well as a close ally of Bail Organa's, was on the agenda, and she chose to yield some of her time to Organa due to an 'important point of order'. Organa then invoked [[Article 17-252]], a piece of legislation proposed by the [[Imperial Ruling Council|Emperor's Council]] directly that "a senior senator, in the case of emergency, may yield the floor freely without interruption to another senior senator." Given that all three - Erveen, Organa, and Mothma, were all senior senators, they were free to yield this time, and as article 17-252 was in effect the speaker did not have the power to override Mothma's speech. The ISB, however, did attempt to shut down the public broadcast of Mothma's speech.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

{{ExcerptIU|Fellow senators, friends, colleagues… allies, adversaries… I stand before you this morning with a heavy heart. I've spent my life in this chamber. I came here as a child… and as I look around me now, I realize that I have almost no memories that predate my arrival, and few bonds that cleave so tightly. Through these many years, I believe I have served my constituents honorably and upheld our code of conduct. This chamber is a cauldron of opinions, and we've certainly all had our patience and tempers tested in our pursuit of our ideals. Disagree as we might, I am hopeful that those of you who know me will vouch for my credibility in the days to come. I stand this morning with a difficult message. I believe we are in crisis. The distance between what is said and what is known to be true has become an abyss. Of all the things at risk, the loss of an objective reality is perhaps the most dangerous. The death of truth is the ultimate victory of evil. When truth leaves us, when we let it slip away, when it is ripped from our hands, we become vulnerable to the appetite of whatever monster screams the loudest. This chamber's hold on the truth was finally lost on the Ghorman Plaza. What took place yesterday… what happened yesterday on Ghorman was unprovoked genocide. Yes, genocide! And that truth has been exiled from this chamber! And the monster screaming the loudest? The monster we've helped create? The monster who will come for us all soon enough… is Emperor Palpatine!|attrib=Mon Mothma gives her final address to the Imperial Senate|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}

The speech, aimed at both elected officials in the Senate and the galaxy's diverse inhabitants,<ref name="Mon Mothma Senate speech">{{WebCite|url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/awards/story/2025-08-19/andor-disney-mon-mothma-senate-speech-annotated-dan-gilroy|text=Mon Mothma's Senate speech, annotated: Inside the year's most powerful monologue|author=Matt Brennan|date=2025-08-19|work=[https://www.latimes.com Los Angeles Times]|archivedate=20250821202709}}</ref> was met with loud jeering and rejection on the Senate floor, as well as the end of the current session due to the shutdown of the public broadcast.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

=====Escaping the Empire=====
{{Quote|I name the Emperor himself for ordering the brutal attacks on the people of Ghorman. Their peaceful world is one of countless systems helpless against his oppressive rule. This massacre is proof that our self-appointed Emperor is little more than a lying executioner, imposing his tyranny under the pretense of security. We cannot allow this evil to stand.|Mon Mothma's transmission to the galaxy after fleeing the Senate|<ref name="Secret Cargo" />}}
[[File:Andor-EscapeFromTheSenate.png|thumb|left|300px|An ISB agent attempts to arrest Mothma as she tries to leave the Senate building.]]
Immediately following the speech, ISB forces ordered her arrest and that authorities prevent her from leaving the senate building. With her driver an ISB double agent, her office was raided and the building was shut down with the ISB believing she would not use deadly force to escape. Meanwhile, she met Cassian Andor, who communicated his identity through the code phrase 'I have friends everywhere' as well as revealing to Mon that he and Mon's cousin, Vel, were the last survivors of the [[Aldhani heist|heist on Aldhani]]. They headed at first towards the loading bay, where Luthen and Kleya were waiting with a ship, but after the ISB agent managed by Lonni Jung in Organa's extraction team tried to intervene and arrest Mothma, the Imperial Navy had time to lock down that part of the building. Instead, Mothma lead Andor back to her parked private car, where Andor killed the vehicle's driver - ISB-paid Kloris - taking control of the vehicle and escaping to a [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse of Luthen's]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

At the safehouse, Mothma thanked Andor, before he left to return to Yavin IV with an injured [[Wilmon Paak]] and [[Dreena]] of the [[Ghorman Front]]. [[Kleya Marki]], Rael's associate, revealed to Mothma that Rael was safe. Marki then handed Mothma, along with Erskin Semaj, over to the [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], a bomber squad associated with Bail Organa that,<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> for publicity purposes, was encharged with delivering Mothma<ref name="EmmysQA">{{YouTube|video=dPLJESDwpU0|text=Andor S2 Emmys Q&A - Tony Gilroy - Dan Gilroy|channel=backstorymagazine2757|name=Backstory Magazine|date=2025-08-25}}</ref> to Dantooine<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> and then to Yavin as well as rally the current formation of the Rebel Alliance with the message that it was they who had broken Mothma out of the senate.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

Following the escape, ISB agents also visited Cantham House on Coruscant, the meeting place of the [[Cantham House meetings]], based on suspicions they had, and questioned Leia and several others there.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> After being picked up by Gold Squadron, Mothma delivered another speech<ref name="ChangedSpeech">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/why-andor-diverged-from-canon-mon-mothmas-epic-senate-speech-11729531|text=Andor star Genevieve O'Reilly and creator break down Mon Mothma's epic Senate speech, diverging from canon|author=Maureen Lee Lenker|date=2025-05-07|work=''Entertainment Weekly''|archivedate=20250507183159}}</ref> on the [[HoloNet]]<ref name="Vader 54">{{DarthVaderCite|54|The Dark Side}}</ref> in which she denounced the Emperor as a "lying executioner."<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

=====Operation Handoff=====
{{Quote|We're in the process of building an alliance, uniting the various rebel cells across the galaxy. My challenge to the Emperor was a call to stand against the Empire. My hope is, all who answer it will see that they are not alone. I must be there to meet them.|Mothma, to Hera Syndulla|<ref name="Secret Cargo" />}}
[[File:ChandrilaMistress-RebelsS03E18.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Chandrila Mistress'' docks with the ''Ghost''.]]
Mothma traveled aboard her [[freighter]] the ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]'' with Semaj and her Gold Squadron escort, intending to arrive at Dantooine before a meeting there and broadcast a third speech that would be shown throughout the galaxy, specifically targeting rebel factions that could come together to form the next chapter of the alliance. [[Phoenix Leader]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s crew, who were members of the [[Lothal sector]]-based [[Phoenix Cell]], was dispatched by Bail Organa to rendezvous with the ''Chandrila Mistress'' and provide them with fuel. When Syndulla's crew, known as the [[Spectres]], docked their ship, the ''Ghost'', with Mothma's ship and started refueling, Semaj kept them in the dark about who the ship was delivering. After the ''Chandrila Mistress'' was attacked by Imperial forces, she and her crew abandoned their ship and sought refuge aboard the ''Ghost''. Mothma helped Syndulla's droid [[C1-10P|Chopper]] to detach the ''Ghost'' from her stricken freighter.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

After escaping into [[hyperspace]], Hera introduced her crew to Mothma. Mothma praised both [[Ezra Bridger]], who was flying [[Gold Two (rebellion)|Gold Two's]] Y-wing starfighter, and the [[Lasat]] Captain [[Garazeb Orrelios]] for their services to the Rebellion. Ezra thanked Mothma for her speech criticizing the Emperor. When Erskin counseled her to abandon her planned mission to [[Dantooine]], Mothma refused and argued that she had to be present at the meeting. Mothma then informed the Spectres that she was planning to build an alliance of rebel cells to challenge the Empire and unify the rebellion. After Erskin warned them that the Empire was trying to intercept any ship leaving the system, Hera decided they would travel through the dangerous [[Archeon pass]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

[[File:Nebula_fight.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Ghost'' travels through the Archeon Nebula, pursued by Imperials.]]
During the journey, the rebels came under [[Operation Handoff|attack]] from [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] prototype [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] starfighter and two [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE Interceptors]]. Three Y-wings were lost during the skirmish but the rebels also managed to destroy the two TIE interceptors. While [[Gold Leader]] Captain [[Jon Vander]] and Ezra distracted the TIE Defender, Hera flew the ''Ghost'' out of the Archeon Nebula only to find their way blocked by two Star Destroyers commanded by Governor [[Arihnda Pryce]] and Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

While Hera and Chopper readied the ''Ghost''{{'s}} hyperdrive, Mothma tried to stall Governor Pryce with a list of demands. Pryce however rejected her demands and ordered Konstantine to activate the Star Destroyer's [[tractor beam projector]]. Before the ''Ghost'' could be drawn inside the Star Destroyer, Vander and Ezra emerged from the Archeon Nebula. Under Hera's orders, they fired their [[proton torpedo]]es into the nebula. This caused an explosion which badly damaged the two Star Destroyers and allowed the rebels to flee to Dantooine.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

=====Forming the Alliance=====
{{Quote|This is Senator Mon Mothma, I have been called a traitor for speaking out against a corrupt Galactic Senate. A Senate manipulated by the sinister tactics of the Emperor. For too long I have watched the heavy hand of the Empire strangle our liberties, stifling our freedoms in the name of ensuring our safety. No longer! Despite Imperial threats, despite the Emperor himself, I have no fear as I take new action. For I am not alone. Beginning today we stand together as allies. I hereby resign from the Senate to fight for you, not from the distant hall of politics but from the front lines. We will not rest until we bring an end to the Empire, until we restore our Republic! Are you with me?|Mon Mothma unites the various rebel cells|<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>}}
[[File:Secret_Cargo.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Senator Mothma onboard the ''Ghost''.]]
Above Dantooine, Mon Mothma gave a speech stating that she had resigned from the Imperial Senate since it had been corrupted by the Emperor. With the Senate no longer able to protect the rights and freedom of the galaxy's citizens, she advocated the formation of an Alliance to Restore the Republic. This speech was witnessed by Senator Organa, General [[Jan Dodonna]], and members of [[Ryder Azadi]]'s [[Lothal resistance group]] and Phoenix Squadron. Shortly later, the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|rebel fleet]] emerged from hyperspace above Dantooine and the Alliance was formed,<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> officially beginning the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Insider 203">{{InsiderCite|203|A Certain Point of View}}</ref> Members of the [[Alliance Military]] would nickname Mothma "Double-M."<ref name="Rendezvous Point">{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> Mothma was then eventually delivered to Yavin, as Gold Squadron had originally intended.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

====Raid on Lothal====
Weeks later, Mothma informed Ezra of a message from Azadi concerning a new development of the TIE Defender. Mon Mothma later attended a briefing with General Dodonna, Senator Organa, Semaj, and Syndulla to discuss the flight data recorder. During the meeting, Hera urged Mothma to launch a [[Attack on Lothal|strike]] on the Imperial TIE Defender factories on Lothal and added that she had a ground strike team. Mothma responded by asking her and Chopper to wait outside while she discussed the matter. In private, Mothma and the others discussed [[Protocol 13]]. Hera re-entered the meeting and urged the rebel leadership to launch the strike. Mothma was swayed and authorized Syndulla's strike.<ref name="Crawler Commandeers">{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}}</ref> However, Syndulla's squadron of [[X-wing starfighter]]s was intercepted and largely wiped out by Thrawn's Seventh Fleet.<ref name="Rebel Assault">{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}}</ref>
